question: Is the spread/losing-side offset copula consistent across classes and chain-held-out TRAIN code states, and does the transition codebook encode an absolute or path-dependent price coordinate?
tier: B for supplied-data identities; C for physical interpretation and competition transfer
selection: metadata SHA256 order; unique test components; fit excludes all test components; exclude previous provided/clock evaluation components; labels and masks unopened for selection
columns: i0_p0..i0_p21, t0, t1 only; no masks or seq_ix
price_keys: float32 code fields rounded to four decimals, matching historical grammar; separately count rounded aliases
interior_spread_fit: Only rows with both integer target values <=0 and -(t0+t1)>=1; code mode support>=3 and confidence>=0.95
offset_test: On held-out outside-branch rows sharing accepted interior TRAIN code, k=-losing_target-mapped_interior_spread. Offset2 law is rejected when supported recurrence gives persistent non2 offsets; unknown coverage stays explicit
transition_test: TRAIN modal target-jump movement on interior-to-interior events, confidence>=0.8 and support>=3; compare same eligible events in held-out chains. This assumes common future reference stability and is supervised diagnostic only
cycles: Inspect accepted movement edges for reverse and graph-potential consistency; nonzero closed-code displacement rejects an absolute price coordinate but does not reject relative book-shape encoding
linear_control: Per diagnostic target-derived class, fixed ridge0.001 on 22 raw price fields plus intercept, <=256 evenly spaced interior event states per group; no tuning
quiet_rows: Measure target changes and target-inverted spread changes inside full-price-code plateaus over all TRAIN rows; no scoring mask
falsifiers: interior-spread code ambiguity across held-out chains
offset differs from2 on confidently mapped test code
transition vote loses consistency across chains
allowed_data: supplied TRAIN only; external mechanism data neither read nor fitted in this probe
budget: one thread, CPUQuota100%, MemoryMax2GiB, RuntimeMax60s, no GPU, <=96 groups, no background shell
